findings.rationale: Verified: plan section (b) rows 6-7 and the QC row check only text; (b) now has per-row git or uploaded-receipt derivation, and non-derivable stages are marked telemetry with warn-level order checks.
Verified: skills/finish-flow/SKILL.md Merge row merges only after qc passes, so a merge-dependent qc-gate row is circular; (b) now keys rows to leaving-code-review and finish/accept.
Verified: scripts/check-phase-review-receipt.js:113 makes --phase-base mandatory; fixed in the (b) code-review row (derived by merge-base), P2 acceptance has a mismatch negative control.

Verified: an internal checksum alone cannot catch a stale or re-checksummed export; (d) adds source_sha256 against the pinned stage-graph.json, version compare and negative controls, degrade-and-warn per fleet review.
Verified: scripts/stage-graph.js:110-117 moves code-review only when it is in the walk; (c) splits the urgent-low row into M/L/XL and XS/S.
Accepted: (i) labels each alarm new or existing and observed or assumption; KR2 replay now maps to T0 and P4 owner-task check.
Accepted: (j) uses 有 where capability exists and assigns every row an owner from the allowed set; check-backlog-entries.js:26-39 --ready cited.

Verified: session-mode.js:26-39,1141,1200 --new-task semantics; the MCP task_accept tool is the requester side; (a) now specifies --new-task, unresolved handling without stage-advance, a named hook file and a probe for the trigger.

Verified against the first-draft (b): finish/Used rows were merged and trailer was checked only for non-emptiness; split into separate rows with PASS format and used checks, non-derivable stages labelled telemetry.

Verified: finish-flow Delete-merged-branch row removes the branch, dispatch-plan-review.js:81 keeps artifacts under ~/.autopilot, check-phase-review-receipt.js:113 needs --phase-base; (b) adds uploaded receipts, derived phase-base, plan-first by commit order, and per-event timing.

Verified: stage-graph.js:104 ignores explore when bug, :110-117 urgent-low, stage-graph.json bump_limits M 20/800 and unit_kind phase; (c) table and diagram corrected, loop-backs and the intent-to-proposal edge drawn.

Verified: stale export undetected by a self-checksum, canonicalization undefined, scripts/sync-manifest.json absent from the file map; (d) defines canonical form and source_sha256 checks, section 3 lists the manifest; fail-open circularity removed by degrade-and-warn.

Verified: work-order-plan.js:15-17 parses only Size and Plan; the single issue.type enum cannot hold bug+urgent. (e) now maps to fleet SizeTag and stage.stage/fine with reported telemetry kept apart, and the full gate id is written.

Verified: session-mode.js:216-233 refuses inherited ids under a parent session; (f) requires an explicit fresh --session-id, drops the noncq line (noncq items never call task_result) and defines the verifier as read-only by default.

Verified: pm-dispatch-plan-guard.test.js:10,115-139 holds the only isPmConsole tests and hooks.json matcher is at :195 (not :184); (g) moves the tests first, narrows the matcher and lists every file naming the stem.

Verified: the first draft had no phases block while P4 needs this plan to parse; fleet-task.js:11-13 shows --blocked-on takes member and card targets; (h) adds the block, owner grammar, --repo and a trigger, and (i) scopes T0 to task-id edges and drops the bare character 等 from T3.
Verified: the first-draft (j) used - as an owner and omitted 有 for existing capability (check-backlog-entries.js --ready); table rewritten with allowed owners only.

Verified: the first-draft P5 mixed fleet and capacity deliverables and section 3 lacked the plan-phases schema; phases split into P6a, P6b, P7 with single owners, schemas/plan-phases.schema.json added to P4.

Verified (export regenerates in memory; checksums prove nothing): section 4(d) now regenerates from four inputs incl. evidence rules and COARSE_OF_NODE and byte-compares; negative control deletes one rule with recomputed checksum; section 3 adds fleet-flow-evidence.json.

Verified (qc-gate row said no merge exists): section 4(b) rows 3 and 5 split pre-merge derivation (intended target + candidate tip, git merge-base) from finish reconcile; P2 acceptance adds a pre-merge fixture with no merge commit.

Verified (finish rows ignored urgent-low deferral, finish-flow Post-finish code-review row): section 4(b) row 7 defines the urgent-low finish sequence, deferred row 3 and the post-finish check; P2 tests the full sequence.

Verified (git log fallback returned no sha and no task binding): section 4(b) row 5 discovers the merge by exact Fleet-Task trailer on the target with refusal on zero or several; negative control is an unrelated latest commit with a valid trailer.

Verified (pre-push has_evidence checks only that a trailer or .qc artifact exists, scripts/lib/qc-evidence.sh): section 4(b) row 6 derives QC from check-test-outcome.js and .qc artifacts bound to the merge, trailer is a summary, XS/S covered; negative control trailer with record deleted.

Verified (session-mode.js has no --session-id, :993-1000 stores resolved with null size, check-hook-inventory.js:71-75 and :184-185 derive stem from filename): sections 3 and 4(a) add the session-mode.js edits, --new-task on any task-scoped state and rename the hook to hooks/work-order-adopt.js.

Verified (timing, phase-base, plan-first discovery, qc-gate row, Used, per finish-flow item 7 and stage-advance.js:94): section 4(b) states re-derivation runs at task_result and accept, phase-base by merge-base with covering reconcile, plan-first path rule excluding explore-synthesis and INDEX, row 4 stage-order only with a warn code, Used as a task_result line with a resolvable token.

Verified (Mode B reads four files and never reads verdict, check-phase-review-receipt.js:298-455; Mode A has packets, chain, post-head modes; trailer reviewer id is not a ledger seat id): section 4(b) rows 2, 3, 6, 7 bundle all four plan files, select Mode by bundle shape, drop the reviewer-in-ledger check and handle urgent-low.

Verified (same hole as the first R5 candidate, a recomputed checksum plus unchanged inputs passes): section 4(d) replaces checksum checks with whole-content regeneration over all four generator inputs and a clean-pin check; negative controls (1) deleted rule, (2) older export after COARSE_OF_NODE change, (3) stale stage-graph.

Verified (no kind enum, CLI or plan-first representation in the plan): section 4(e) adds the Receipt kind enum and bundle format, the fleet-flow-verify CLI flags and autopilot.fleet-flow-verdict/1 output, and Task.plan_blob for plan-first.

Verified (R7 asked for receipts and dispatch-author.sh header says read-only): section 4(f) gives the exact seven-step CLI sequence for codex/agy/grok lanes and drops the dispatch-author attachment; the sequence lives in references/multi-agent-portability.md (section 3, P3).

Verified (work-order-plan.js:15-17 parses only Size: lines; hooks/fleet-send-work-order-guard.js:64-76 enforces both Size and Plan): section 4(g) orders P2 promoted on the PM host, P6a live with both refusals observed, then P8 with pm-console stub controls (:262-274) preserved.

Verified (T1-T4 had field names only, T3 would fire on card waits, conditional P5 and legacy tables undefined): section 4(i) table cites fleet constants and exempts member, d-card and waiting_on_operator waits from T3; section 4(h) adds conditional phases and legacy-table fallback; no new numbers per PM 01M7RTGA.

Verified (P7 had no consumer, P4 used_by differed, mirror and registry files omitted, sync-manifest ritual sync-codex-plugin-skills): P6b now depends on P7 and consumes its rows (4(j), phases), P4 used_by is identical in block and table, section 3 lists the Codex mirror and the P3 registries.
